data.action: 踩在清澈浅水海浪中，手扶墨镜回眸，鲨鱼尾在海水中激起晶莹水花
data.description: 【艾莲·乔 · 碧海清波的鲨鱼泳姿】夏日灿烂艳阳下的金沙浅海，碧蓝清澈的波浪轻轻拍击着艾莲细嫩的脚踝。她身穿红黑相间的运动分体泳装，单手推起墨镜，结实修长的深海鲨鱼尾巴在清澈海水间轻快划动，激起一圈圈纯白的浪花泡沫，整个人宛如真正回到归宿的海洋游猎少女。
data.lighting: 明澈热带阳光与水面反射的跳跃焦散光斑
data.promptProse: Ellen stands in golden beach shallows in her black-and-vermilion athletic swimsuit and cropped dark cover-up, pushing up her red visor with one hand. Her shark tail moves through clear water and sends out rings of foam. The full-body three-quarter view leaves blue waves behind and sand visible below. Tropical sunshine catches the tail's water droplets and shark-print trim, while shifting water reflections ripple over the nearby shore.
data.title: 艾莲·乔 · 碧海清波的鲨鱼泳姿
